name: example_scene
prompt: a roadside gas station at dusk, wet asphalt, the canopy lights on, mountains behind
_help: render 1344x768 -> RealESRGAN -> cover-fit to target -> refine (hires fix). Add "init" + "denoise" to start from a picture, "control": {"type": "canny", "strength": 0.6} to lock its layout, "face_fix": true when people are in frame, "target": [2560, 1080] for a scrolling street.
